Chainlink is a decentralized oracle network that supplies external data to smart contracts on blockchains. Chainlink relies on independent node operators that retrieve and aggregate data before it is delivered on-chain. Chainlink uses its native LINK token. Chainlink is designed to work across multiple blockchains.

Sereum is a runtime protection approach for Ethereum smart contracts against re-entrancy attacks. Sereum monitors contract execution at runtime to detect and prevent re-entrancy attacks. Sereum is designed to protect existing smart contracts without requiring them to be rewritten.

Ronin Bridge is a cross-chain bridge that connects the Ronin sidechain with Ethereum. Ronin Bridge is operated by a set of validators that authorize asset transfers between chains. Ronin Bridge serves the Axie Infinity ecosystem. Ronin Bridge was exploited in March 2022, when attackers gained control of validator keys.
